Cost 1 Conviction

Range 30 feet

Targets your Ward

Duration 1 minute

For a while your Ward is harder to hurt than you are, which is the point.

Your Ward gains resistance 5 to all damage (resistance 10 at 16th level). You gain none of it — that's the point. The resistance doesn't stack with Ash Already Falling; a creature under both uses the higher against fire.
